final: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), overall AS (SELECT SUM(state_total) AS overall_total FROM state_totals), shares AS (SELECT st.state_total, 1.0 * st.state_total / o.overall_total AS share FROM state_totals AS st JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.state_total), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
